name: Torrelodones (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, blue above and yellow below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Torrelodones (a tower on white and a tree on yellow).
history: The flag of Torrelodones was approved by the Community of Madrid on 12 February 1992 to a design by Julián Nieto Martín; it is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, divided diagonally into two equal parts from the top of the hoist to the bottom of the fly, blue above and yellow below, with the crowned arms at the centre. The status of villa was granted in 1728.
